description: Requires a QuantGeeks plan; not available without signing in (the call asks the user to sign in) or with a free account (the call says it needs a plan). Per-strike gamma exposure (GEX by default; `measure` 'vex' returns the VEX ladder, vanna exposure), ONE column for ONE expiration: by default the latest minute and 20 strikes each side of spot, as on the QuantGeeks desk. The reply opens with the expiration (same-day or days out) and the key nodes (primary and two majors). Sizes compare only within one expiration (one book); same-day (0DTE) and later expirations are not comparable. Give `center` (a strike) or `from_strike` and `to_strike` to look away from spot, `time` (HH:MM ET) for another minute, `strikes` (up to 60) to widen. Net gamma is QuantGeeks GEX (flow-based); net vanna, with `measure` 'vex', is VEX; both exact, a readable string such as +$2.0M or −$10.0M (quote it as written) with dollars beside it. For nodes over several sessions use quantgeeks_get_node_history; for forward expirations side by side, quantgeeks_get_expiration_map.

center.description: Center the window on this strike instead of spot (e.g. 6550).

date.description: Session date, YYYY-MM-DD (US Eastern). Default: the most recent regular session.

expiration.description: Option expiration YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the nearest.

from_strike.description: Lowest strike of a range to show (with to_strike).

measure.description: 'gex' (default): QuantGeeks GEX (gamma exposure); 'vex': VEX (vanna exposure). Every number and node in the answer is in the measure it says.

strikes.description: Strikes on each side of spot (default 20, at most 60).

symbol.description: Ticker, e.g. SPX (maps to its 0DTE option root SPXW), SPY, QQQ, VIX.

time.description: Time of day HH:MM US Eastern. Default: the latest available minute.

to_strike.description: Highest strike of a range to show.

name: quantgeeks_get_gex_ladder
title: GEX ladder (VEX on request)
